goal: Let a coach dismiss a coaching card for good.

currentState.claim: A dismissed card comes back on the next page load, because dismissal lives in component state.

outcome: A card a coach dismisses stays dismissed, on every device and after a re-login.

approach.summary: Store one dismissal row per coach and card, written when the coach dismisses it.
Filter dismissed cards out of the coaching feed query.
Offer an undo for ten seconds, so a mis-click is not permanent.

noAlternativesReason: No credible alternative: the feed already reads per-coach state, so a dismissal row is the same shape as the data beside it.
assumptions: A dismissal is per coach, not per team: two coaches on one team dismiss independently.

risks.claim: A coach who dismisses every card sees an empty feed and no way back.

risks: The feed query gains a join on the dashboard's slowest page.

decision.prompt: Approve storing dismissals per coach, with a ten-second undo.
